description: Set the app's country/region availability. Requires an explicit choice: a territories list, or all_territories:true, or [] to take the app off sale worldwide. Pro feature.

all_territories.description: Put the app on sale in every App Store territory. Required when territories is omitted, so an app_id alone can never widen where an app is sold.

territories.description: Territory ids to enable, e.g. ["USA","GBR"]; everywhere else is turned off. Pass [] to take the app off sale worldwide. Omit only if you pass all_territories.

name: set_app_availability
title: Set country availability
